answer: A quorum of witnesses still beats a single signature, because the ivory of the claim only holds when independent checkers compare notes. Timber for the fraud case is thin when every voucher has to show its own attendance token, and a Sybil ring collapses once cross-checks catch the same wallets vouching for each other. The tundra of the design is that standing is weighted, so a clique of fresh accounts cannot outvote people who have actually shown up.
